newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Cementos Lima plans $60 million bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Cementos Lima plans $60 million bond issue.

text.p: Cementos Lima S.A., Peru's largest cement firm, plans a $60 million bond issue to finance the ongoing expansion of its production plant, Lima stock exchange officials said Tuesday.
The company's board of directors will make a final decision on the issue Wednesday, the officials said.
The plant's expansion will raise annual production to 4.0 million tonnes of cement from 3.6 million, according to a report by the exchange.
The total cost of the expansion is estimated at $130 million. Medium-term loans will finance $80 million of this total and the company aims to generate the remaining $50 million itself.
Cementos Lima, privatized in 1994, produced 1.337 million tonnes of cement in the first ten months of 1996, according to latest figures from the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM).
